description: Progress of an episode’s render (latest version, or `versao`): queued (with position), rendering (%), ready or failed (with why). When the voice stopped the render it says why and the options to offer the user; when a backup voice narrated (the user turned it on) it says so. Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
